answer: Use staged trust for new identities: each starts with a violet marker and very low transaction limits, and only earns higher limits after completing audited, useful work over time. A grove of established agents must approve each promotion, so newly spun-up identities cannot immediately move value or vote. An attacker would therefore need to pay for sustained, genuine work for every fake identity, making a large sybil army far more expensive than the influence it could buy, rather than letting one plume of cheap copies flood the economy.
